detaileddescription.para: data_texture.glsl reads the width from the bound texture, so this is the only definition.

briefdescription.para: Returns range shifted by fraction of its extent; a positive fraction raises both bounds.

detaileddescription.para: With logarithmic set, the shift is applied in log10 space, so both bounds are scaled by the same ratio. A range that is not positive is shifted linearly instead. Returns range unchanged when a bound would leave the range of a double.

memberdef.argsstring: (const ValueRange &range, qreal factor, qreal anchorRatio, bool logarithmic)
memberdef.name: zoomedRange

briefdescription.para: Returns range with its extent multiplied by factor, keeping the value at anchorRatio in place.

detaileddescription.para: anchorRatio is a position inside the range: 0 at min and 1 at max. With logarithmic set, the extent is measured in log10 space. A range that is not positive is zoomed linearly instead. Returns range unchanged when a bound would leave the range of a double: it would not be finite, or in log10 space it would reach zero.

briefdescription.para: Returns the extent multiplier for mouse-wheel zoom with a zoomScaleFactor in (0, 1).

detaileddescription.para: Zooming in multiplies the extent by the factor and zooming out by its reciprocal. A factor of 0 or below counts as 0.01 and a factor of 1 or above as 0.99, so a step always zooms and never collapses the range. Fractional step counts scale partial wheel notches proportionally.

memberdef.name: unboundedGradientCoordinate

briefdescription.para: Returns an unbounded palette coordinate for a data-space value.

detaileddescription.para: Coordinates outside [0, 1] are intentionally preserved for interpolation. Renderers must clamp only after interpolation, immediately before sampling the gradient, so values beyond the configured range retain endpoint colors.

memberdef.name: resolveGradientValueRange

briefdescription.para: Fills each unset gradient value bound of payload from [dataMin, dataMax].

detaileddescription.para: Bounds resolve independently, so a Fixed bound is kept when the other bound uses DataRange.

briefdescription.para: Reads a list of stop objects, each exposing position and color, into position order.

detaileddescription.para: A single stop is duplicated, and the first and last colors are extended to positions 0 and 1. Entries that are not stop-like are skipped.

briefdescription.para: Returns the color stops of a gradient effect: the colormap ramp when set, otherwise the stops of the QML Gradient gradient.

detaileddescription.para: gradient stops are read from its stops list property, falling back to child objects, and normalized like readGradientStopList(). Returns an empty vector when both are null.

briefdescription.para: Returns the grab whose image is closest to pixels in a window at devicePixelRatio.

detaileddescription.para: Qt 6.2 renders the target size in pixels. Later versions multiply it by the device pixel ratio and round, so some pixel counts cannot be rendered and the image can differ from pixels by a pixel; a tie picks the smaller image.

memberdef.name: writeImageFile

briefdescription.para: Writes image to path in format and returns an error message, or an empty string on success.

detaileddescription.para: quality is passed to QImageWriter::setQuality(). Formats without an alpha channel get the image composited over white. The file is replaced atomically, so a failed write leaves an existing file intact. Safe to call from a worker thread.

detaileddescription.para: Falls back to 8192, supported by every target GPU, when the RHI cannot be queried (Qt older than 6.6, or a build without the private Qt API). QACCELPLOT_MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE lowers the result, for example to exercise capacity limits in tests.

briefdescription.para: Returns how many records a series draws that reads them from the data texture by a float vertex id.

detaileddescription.para: A record takes floatsPerRecord floats of the data texture and vertexBytesPerRecord bytes of vertices. The count is limited by the texture size of window's GPU, by the 2^24 ids a float holds exactly, and by QSGGeometry, which sizes its vertex buffer in int bytes.

memberdef.name: stepCorner

briefdescription.para: Returns corner corner of the step from data point from to data point to, in data space.

detaileddescription.para: Corner 0 is data point from. A step corner holds the Y of the data point whose flat step it ends or starts, and is drawn when that data point is valid and the X values placing the corner are usable. Returns std::nullopt for a corner that is not drawn. Matches the line shader.

memberdef.name: linePathPoint

briefdescription.para: Returns path point corner of data point index on the drawn line of pointCount data points.

detaileddescription.para: The last data point has no step after it, so its corners repeat it. Matches the vertices of the line shader.
